vectors.name: admin/interface
vectors.description: The canonical interface document of sparrow.hub.admin v1 (hub-admin section 5): types 64-79, enum sigils 64-70 (kind 0), service 0 Admin with methods 0-11. Method flags: 0x1 (idempotent) on get, validate, confirm, deleteSecret, listSecrets, putFacet, deleteFacet and listFacets; 0x10 on watch, whose output is [3, Event]; no other flags. An optional field has flag 0x1 and its plain type. The interface document is named sparrow.hub.admin, version "1.0.0", carries no annotations, and its methods list no errors, since every error they use is a core code (hub-admin 5).

vectors.name: admin/facet
vectors.description: A hub's sparrow.hub.admin facet, version 1.0.0, under facet ID 20 (the hub's choice). It implements admin/interface and adds the hint annotation "sparrow.level": "manage" to every method (hub-admin section 1); annotations are not part of wire shapes, so it conforms.

vectors.name: admin/stored-facet-key
vectors.description: The stored-facet key putFacet returns for facet/acme-charts (hub-admin 2.1): the hub puts the document it receives (here unsorted, under facet ID 17) into canonical form with its ID set to 0 and its name kept, and the key is 0x01 || SHA-256 of those bytes. The facet hash of the same facet blanks the name as well (core 6.6), so the two differ; a hub lists facets by stored-facet key in NodeConfig.facets and by facet hash in schemas.

vectors.name: admin/value/config
vectors.description: A Config (type 64) with five nodes: acme.charts dialing in with its credential secret and listing its stored facet by stored-facet key; acme.notes dialed (NodeConfig.dial, field 0) at an https URL with a 32-byte pin and the credential secret the hub presents; acme.sensor dialing in; hub-b, a peer hub dialing in; acme.old, disabled. defaults maps the Renderer interface hash to acme.charts, and extensions carries the reference server's ref.policy as an embedded CBOR document. Absent optional fields are null and trailing nulls are omitted.
